comments: 2026-08-17: merged the separate 'Newsletters » Topics » Media » Economist' rule
(matched @go.economist.com / @economist.com, moved to a different folder) into
this one so all Economist mail lands in one place. '@economist.com' as a contains
match already covers 'clientmarketing@economist.com', so that condition was dropped.
set_keywords) after confirming iCloud silently drops custom IMAP keywords -- see
memory icloud-custom-keyword-limit.md. Now a single self-contained age-gated rule:

only mechanism that revisits mail already filed outside INBOX.
